g.aria-label: (a) Standard Backprop: Saves All L = 18 Blocks Internals (L · 20d)
8.9 GiB headroom fits only ~2,800 tokens (2–3 sequences of 1,024)
(b) Checkpointed: Saves Only Block Inputs (L · 4d) + 1 Recomputed Block
18 × 8 KiB inputs (144 KiB/tok) + 1 live block (160 KiB) → > 3× token capacity!
Fits 10,000–15,000 tokens! Cost: 1 extra forward pass (+2N FLOPs/tok ≈ +25% step time)
